content: /var/log is the biggest SD-card write hotspot on Pi OS. Mitigations: log2ram (redirects /var/log to a RAM-backed tmpfs, flushed to disk periodically/on shutdown) or manual tmpfs mount; cap journald with SystemMaxUse=20-50MB in /etc/systemd/journald.conf; add noatime mount option; add commit=900 to delay ext4 write-flush to SD. These reduce wear from OS/app logging but are optional hardening for a hobby single-user Pi — not essential to get a working deployment, more of a longevity nice-to-have.
